download_evalmuse_dataset: download the EvalMuse dataset from HuggingFace and save prompts to a JSONL file
load_evalmuse_prompts: load all EvalMuse prompts from the downloaded JSONL file into a lookup dictionary
get_evalmuse_prompt_by_id: get a specific EvalMuse prompt by its string ID from the downloaded data
review_download_function: review the download function that fetches test.json from HuggingFace and processes unique prompts
refactor_load_prompts: refactor the load_prompts function to support additional filtering or caching options
